# Feedback clustering

1. Gather feedback since the last run: feedback issues, support notes, usage events.
2. Group by user problem, not by requested solution. Merge duplicates.
3. Per theme: short name, count, affected users or segments, 2–3 verbatim quotes with links, and the usage signal if any.
4. Rank by reach × severity; mark themes that match existing issues.
5. Propose at most five new issues per run, each with the theme evidence; link the rest to existing issues.

Never include personal data beyond what the source issue already shows.
